name: Tsuyuguchi Manami
source:
A manager at Ubai who handles the makeup of actresses, lighting, and sometimes camera work. 

She also works as a model and has nude pictures of her taken, but without showing her face. 

Her work in the other Ubai includes scouting, client relations, and investigation. For some reason, she can sniff out women who can potentially work at Ubai, or people who might be interested in becoming members. She was also the one who found Ryousuke and recruited him to work under her. 

She looks at society with mocking eyes, and is a sarcastic person.

At Ubai Again, she incited Ryousuke, and will decide whether he has what it takes to follow through Gen's footsteps. 

[spoiler]Manami is a child born from the adultery of her mother with Gen. She uses this info as blackmail to have sex with Gen whenever she wants.[/spoiler]
